objections.label: How did you get my info?

recommendations.title: Reframe the credit range question
recommendations.headline: 14% of borrowers asked about credit range stopped replying, vs 4% at a typical question.
evidence: 29 of 201 borrowers stopped at this question (14%).
Median drop-off at the other 6 questions: 4%.
Credit is the most sensitive question we ask; borrowers often assume it triggers a credit pull.
recommendations.change: Ask credit last, lead with "no credit check, just your best guess," and make "not sure" an easy answer. Allow a transfer without it, since the loan officer will review credit anyway.
recommendations.config_snippet:
qualification:
  fields:
    # move credit_band after occupancy and timeline
    - id: credit_band
      required: false   # loan officer confirms credit
      ask: >-
        Lead with "this isn't a credit check, just your best guess," and offer
        "not sure" as an answer.
recommendations.validate: Re-run the eval suite (recall and borrower experience must hold), then watch credit range drop-off weekly. Target: at or below 6%.
recommendations.impact: If drop-off here matched a typical question, about 18 more qualified leads over these 4 weeks (synthetic estimate).

recommendations.title: Stop promising a 5-minute call on weekends
recommendations.headline: Only 60% of weekend transfers reached a loan officer, vs 96% on weekdays.
evidence: 12 of 30 weekend transfers did not connect within the promised window.
75% of borrowers whose transfer didn't connect ended the conversation frustrated.
The agent's transfer message says "usually within 5 minutes," which is untrue on weekends.
recommendations.change: On weekends, offer a scheduled call instead of a live transfer, or tell the borrower the honest wait. Share the connect-rate gap with the lender's sales manager: it may be a staffing fix, not an agent fix.
recommendations.config_snippet:
handoff:
  live_transfer_available: business_hours
  business_hours: { days: [mon, tue, wed, thu, fri], start: "08:00", end: "21:00" }
  after_hours_guidance: >-
    Offer a call at a time that works; don't promise an immediate callback.
recommendations.validate: Add a weekend persona to the eval suite (expected: callback, clear next step). Then track weekend connect rate and frustrated endings weekly.
recommendations.impact: About 3 fewer broken "5-minute" promises per week (synthetic estimate).

recommendations.title: Use a source-aware opener for comparison site leads
recommendations.headline: 22% of comparison site leads opted out, vs 6% from the lender's own web form.
evidence: 30% of these leads asked some form of "how did you get my info?" (web form: 5%).
They came through a third-party site, so a Harborline text feels unexpected. The opener references "the inquiry you just submitted" without saying where.
Qualification rate for this source: 43% (web form: 51%).
recommendations.change: Pass the lead source to the agent and name it in the first message ("you requested refinance quotes on [partner site] a moment ago"). Keep the STOP reminder.
recommendations.config_snippet:
channel:
  trigger_by_source:
    rate_comparison_partner: >-
      The borrower requested refinance quotes on a rate-comparison site a moment
      ago and chose Harborline as one of the lenders to contact them. Say so.
recommendations.validate: Add a partner-sourced persona to the eval suite; then watch opt-out and "how did you get my info?" rates for this source weekly.
recommendations.impact: If opt-outs fell to the web-form rate, about 13 more conversations kept over these 4 weeks (synthetic estimate).
